title: Fabrication · NQ-Open
notes: Per-context mean over retained rollout scores; missing scores stay missing. Every label file is SHA-256 matched to the R2FAIR scoring manifest. WildChat uses only sha1(context_id) mod 5 == 4, matching the displayed held-out correlations. Eleven pooled cells match the comparison's sample counts. Synthetic instructions are pooled into one distribution per trait. NQ-Open/SimpleQA use fabrication rates times 100; other cells use graded trait scores. Empirical frequencies, no confidence intervals or smoothing; no generation, judging, or fitting.
